DEPARTURE_SIGNAL.description: Indication that migrants may be preparing to depart or have recently departed.

ROUTE_INFORMATION.description: Information about migration routes, crossing points or movement corridors.

BORDER_CROSSING.description: Reported or planned crossing of an international border.

ARRIVAL.description: Reported arrival of migrants at a destination or transit location.

RESCUE_OPERATION.description: Rescue of migrants at sea, on land or in another hazardous environment.

INTERCEPTION.description: Interception or prevention of a migration movement by authorities.

DETENTION.description: Detention or arrest of migrants in connection with migration activity.

SMUGGLING_ACTIVITY.description: Possible migrant smuggling, facilitation or organized transport activity.

TRANSPORT_OFFER.description: Offer or organization of transport connected to migration activity.

COORDINATION.description: Coordination, meeting instructions, contact information or group organization related to migration activity.

TRAVEL_ADVICE.description: Advice or practical guidance related to migration routes, border conditions or movement.

BORDER_CONDITION.description: Information about border controls, patrols, checkpoints, restrictions or enforcement conditions.

BORDER_MEASURE.description: Government or authority action affecting border access, border infrastructure or border policy.

DEPORTATION.description: Deportation, removal or forced return of migrants.

ASYLUM_POLICY.description: Policy, regulation or administrative action related to asylum or refugee processing.

MIGRANT_CAMP.description: Activity or developments involving migrant camps, reception centres or temporary accommodation sites.

NGO_ACTIVITY.description: Migration-related activity involving NGOs, humanitarian organizations or rescue vessels.

CASUALTY.description: Deaths or injuries associated with migration activity.

PROTEST.description: Protest, demonstration or civil unrest related to migration.

GENERAL_DISCUSSION.description: Migration-related discussion without a clearly identifiable operational event.
